title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2025-11-25 (50).webp
desc: Logistic center of the supermarket chain Novus in Kyiv after Russian drone and missile attack in the night and the morning of 25 November 2025. 7 people died in the city (including 4 drivers of the logistic center) and 21 were injured (1, 2).

title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2025-05-07 (02).webp
desc: Residential building in Kyiv after Russian attack with missiles and drones in the night on 7 May 2025. Several residential buildings were damaged, two people died and seven were injured (an article).

title: File:Destructions in Pidserednie after Russian attack, 2025-07-21 (01).jpg
desc: Administrative building in the settlement Pidserednie (Kharkiv region) after Russian drone strike on July 21, 2025.

title: File:Lyceum in Bohodukhiv after Russian attack, 2025-03-15 (11).webp
desc: Lyceum in Bohodukhiv (Kharkiv region of Ukraine) after Russian drone attack in the night on 15 March 2025. Besides the lyceum, 5 school buses and 18 residential buildings were damaged. Four people suffered. Two new strikes during extinguishing of the fire damaged fire engines.

title: File:Destructions in Kharkiv after Russian attack, 2025-04-02 (01).jpg
desc: Residential building in Kharkiv after strike of Russian drone Molniya on 4 April 2025. Five people were injured.

title: File:Destructions in Kyiv after Russian attack, 2026-01-05 (02).jpg
desc: Clinic Medikom in Kyiv (Obolon district) after drone hit during Russian attack on Ukraine by missiles and drones in the night on 5 January 2026. Three people were injured, one patient died (an article).

title: File:Sumy Oblast State Administration after Russian attack, 2025-07-25 (01).jpg
desc: Building of Sumy Oblast State Administration after Russian drone attack on 25 July 2025. The building was attacked 3 times on this week (1, 2, 3).

title: File:Sumy Oblast State Administration after Russian attack, 2025-07-26 (01).jpg
desc: Building of Sumy Oblast State Administration after Russian drone attack on 26 July 2025. The building was attacked 3 times on this week (1, 2, 3).
